title: Smokestack
description: The &3Smokestack&r is used to reduce pollution made from machines. &3Exhaust Pipes&r, made in anvils, can be used to transport the fumes to the Smokestack. The &3Industrial Smokestack&r is needed to produce &6Fine Soot&r, required for making &6Fullerite&r in the late game.
